A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Maladian]] '''commander''' dealt with [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] as the latter attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] off [[Vidar Kim]]. The [[Commander/Legends|commander]], embarrassed by how Kim's assassination was carried out, told Pestage he wanted to make it up to him through another more skillful Maladian [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]], but against who was was left ambiguous to Pestage. Pestage made a rush to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], fearing the Maladian's were attacking him, and was in relief to realize they hadn't. However, Palpatine was suspicious as the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] had just tried to kill him, so he reached out in the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] and realized that [[Magister]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darth Plagueis, was the target of the Maladian assassins, who had accepted a contract by the Gran Protectorate to kill Damask.
